Description: Create app/, core/, db/, data/, config/, tests/ folders per architecture plan; relocate app.py -> app/main.py, utils.py logic into core/chains/retrieval.py, move CSVs into data/. Update imports so the app still runs.
Acceptance Criteria: App runs via `streamlit run app/main.py` with no import errors; existing MENTORING/SCP/PROJECTS/KATHA options still load.

Description: Create the new branch off main; confirm branch name and PR target with team.
Acceptance Criteria: Branch exists and is pushed; confirmed in Slack/verbally with team.

Description: Sign up for OpenRouter, generate API key, add OPENROUTER_API_KEY to .env / secrets, test one manual API call.
Acceptance Criteria: A test curl/python call to OpenRouter's chat completions endpoint returns a valid response.

Description: SQLAlchemy models for sessions, queries, feedback, prompts, model_config per schema in ARCHITECTURE_PLAN.md Section 5. Include Alembic migration setup.
Acceptance Criteria: `alembic upgrade head` creates query_hub.db with all 5 tables; models importable from db/models.py.

Description: core/llm/client.py: factory function reading active model_config row, returning a configured ChatOpenAI client pointed at OpenRouter base_url.
Acceptance Criteria: Client factory returns a working ChatOpenAI instance; a test call against it succeeds using an OpenRouter model.

Description: data/seed_prompts.py: parse the 12 sections of mitra_system_prompt (already in prompts.py) into stage-tagged rows per the stage table in ARCHITECTURE_PLAN.md Section 3.4, insert into prompts table.
Acceptance Criteria: Running the script populates prompts table with one active row per stage key; row count and stage_key values match the plan's table.

Description: Wire the confirmed MItra database into get_db_credentials/get_chain equivalent as a 5th dataset option; produce table_desc_mitra.csv.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting MITRA in the sidebar successfully runs a test SQL query against the real MItra DB.

Description: app/components/feedback_widget.py: thumbs up/down + optional comment box shown after each AI response, writes to feedback table via feedback_repo.
Acceptance Criteria: Clicking up/down (and optionally submitting a comment) creates a row in feedback linked to the correct query_id.

Description: core/chains/interpretation.py: PromptAssembler fetches active rows per applicable stage key from prompts table and concatenates into the final system prompt sent to the LLM.
Acceptance Criteria: For a short factual question, only always-on stages are included; for an exploratory question, executive_structure is also included. Verified by inspecting the assembled prompt string.

Description: db/repositories/: query_repo, feedback_repo, prompt_repo, session_repo with basic CRUD + the specific lookups needed (e.g. get_active_prompt_by_stage, get_history_for_session).
Acceptance Criteria: Each repo has passing unit tests for create/read operations used by the rest of the app.

Description: Wire every chain invocation to write a row to queries (query_id, session_id, timestamp, user_query, generated_sql, ai_response, dataset_option) via query_repo.
Acceptance Criteria: Every question asked in the UI produces exactly one new row in queries with all fields populated.

Description: core/context/history.py: replace Streamlit-only session_state history with history loaded from queries table for the current session_id, fed into MessagesPlaceholder.
Acceptance Criteria: Asking 'How many stories in Bihar in June?' then 'What about Karnataka?' in the same session correctly carries over month context; history also survives a page refresh.

Description: tests/ covering db models, repositories, and prompt assembly logic.
Acceptance Criteria: `pytest` passes with meaningful coverage of db/ and core/chains/interpretation.py.

Description: README.md: setup instructions (env vars, DB init via alembic, running the app), plus a short doc on adding a new prompt stage or model config row.
Acceptance Criteria: A contributor unfamiliar with the project can get the app running locally using only the README.

Description: Merge intern's DB/prompt-store/feedback work with OpenRouter client + Prompt Assembler + context retention into one working chain end-to-end.
Acceptance Criteria: Full chat flow works end-to-end for all 5 dataset options using OpenRouter, with logging and feedback capture active.

Description: Test all 5 datasets, test at least 2 different OpenRouter models via model_config swap, fix bugs found, open PR from v2-makeover into main.
Acceptance Criteria: PR opened with a test summary covering all 5 datasets and at least 2 models; no known blocking bugs.
